title: 第一卷 第325章 你教不了他们
slug: 纨绔世子爷公主退婚我造反
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

刘正平站在那里，脸色一阵青一阵白。

旁边他那几个学生互相看了看，也没人接话。

百姓们等着。

陈炎也等着。

刘正平咬了咬牙。

“世子莫要欺人。”

“这比法不公平。”

“怎么不公平？”陈炎反问。

“你是先生，教孩子认字，这不是你的本行吗？”

“还是说，你只会教有钱人家的孩子，穷人家的你教不了？”

这句话太毒了。

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

Liu Zhengping stood there, his face turning blue and white.

The students next to him looked at each other, but no one answered.

The people were waiting.

Chen Yan is also waiting.

Liu Zhengping gritted his teeth.

"Your Majesty, don't bully others."

"This is not a fair comparison."

"Why is it unfair?" Chen Yan asked back.

"You are a gentleman, teaching children how to read. Isn't this your specialty?"

"Or are you saying that you can only teach children from rich families, but you can't teach children from poor families?"

This sentence is too poisonous.
